library_name: Destiny Core and KOTOR Force Techniques and Secrets
notes: Complete Core techniques and secrets plus all techniques introduced by the KOTOR Campaign Guide. KOTOR adds no separate Force secrets.

rules.name: Force Point Recovery
rules.description: Recover one Force Point spent during an encounter after that encounter ends.

special: Access to a Force technique from a qualifying prestige class

mechanics.trigger: An encounter ends after you spent one or more Force Points during it.
mechanics.effect: Automatically recover 1 Force Point spent during that encounter.
mechanics.special: Cannot recover more than was spent and does not recover Destiny Points.

rules.name: Force Power Mastery
rules.description: Master one Force power well enough to take 10 under pressure.

mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on its Use the Force check even while distracted or threatened.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different Force power each time.

rules.name: Improved Force Trance
rules.description: Recover hit points much faster while maintaining a Force trance.

mechanics.trigger: Remain in a Force trance for at least one hour.
mechanics.effect: Regain hit points equal to twice your character level for every hour spent in the trance.

rules.name: Improved Move Light Object
rules.description: Move a light object more quickly and launch it with less effort.

mechanics.effect: Use Move Light Object as a swift action instead of a move action. Using the object as a projectile requires a move action instead of a standard action.

rules.name: Improved Sense Force
rules.description: Search for Force-users and disturbances more quickly.

mechanics.effect: Use the Sense Force application of Use the Force as a move action instead of a full-round action.

rules.name: Improved Sense Surroundings
rules.description: Open your awareness to unseen surroundings without spending an action.

mechanics.effect: Use the Sense Surroundings application of Use the Force as a free action instead of a swift action.

rules.name: Improved Telepathy
rules.description: Make telepathic contact more reliably.

mechanics.trigger: Use the Telepathy application of Use the Force.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better Use the Force result.

rules.name: Dominate Mind
rules.description: A particularly strong Mind Trick lets you dictate the target's next standard action.

mechanics.trigger: Your Mind Trick activation check exceeds the target's Will Defense by 10 or more.
mechanics.effect: Instead of the normal option, you may choose what the target does with its standard action on its next turn.
mechanics.special: The commanded action remains subject to Mind Trick's normal restrictions.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Improved Energy Resistance
rules.description: Apply Energy Resistance to a nearby ally instead of yourself.

mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares instead of yourself.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains the power's normal protection using your activation result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 53

rules.name: Improved Force Slam
rules.description: Convert Force Slam into a circular burst centered on you.

mechanics.use: Full-round action instead of Force Slam's normal activation time.
mechanics.effect: Target every eligible creature in a 2-square-radius burst centered on you instead of the normal cone.
mechanics.special: Spend 1 Force Point to increase the burst radius to 4 squares.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Force Stun
rules.description: A successful Force Stun also immobilizes its victim briefly.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully affect a target with Force Stun.
mechanics.effect: The target is also immobilized for 1 round.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Ionize
rules.description: Spend a Force Point so Ionize deals its full listed ion damage.

mechanics.effect: The target takes full ion damage instead of halving ion damage after comparison with its damage threshold.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Kinetic Combat
rules.description: Control as many as three weapons simultaneously with Kinetic Combat.

mechanics.effect: Kinetic Combat may control up to three weapons at once.
mechanics.special: Moving and attacking with one of the controlled weapons still requires a standard action; the technique does not grant additional attacks by itself.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Resist Force
rules.description: Apply Resist Force to a nearby ally instead of yourself.

mechanics.target: One ally within 6 squares instead of yourself.
mechanics.effect: The ally gains the power's normal defense using your activation result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Valor
rules.description: Receive Valor's benefits yourself whenever you grant them to an ally.

mechanics.trigger: Activate Valor on an eligible target.
mechanics.effect: You also gain the same benefits from that activation.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Improved Vital Transfer
rules.description: Heal an ally with Vital Transfer from several squares away.

mechanics.target: One eligible target within 6 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Use Vital Transfer at range rather than requiring touch; all other costs and effects remain normal.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Language Absorption
rules.description: Use telepathy to temporarily absorb another creature's language.

mechanics.target: One creature that knows the desired language.
mechanics.check: If unwilling, Use the Force vs. Will Defense as for Telepathy.
mechanics.effect: You can speak and understand one language known by the target.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 54

rules.name: Devastating Power
rules.description: Increase the number of damage dice rolled by a Force power.

special: Access to a Force secret from Force Disciple, Jedi Master, Sith Lord, or equivalent

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power that deals damage.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to increase damage dice by 50%, or 1 Destiny Point to double the number of damage dice.
mechanics.effect: Increase only the power's damage dice; apply normal rounding and other modifiers afterward.
mechanics.special: Normal per-round Force Point and Destiny Point spending limits apply.

rules.name: Distant Power
rules.description: Extend a numerically expressed Force-power range enormously.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power with a numeric range.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to multiply range by 10, or 1 Destiny Point to extend range anywhere in the same star system.
mechanics.special: Does not remove line-of-sight requirements or make a nonnumeric range eligible.

rules.name: Multitarget Power
rules.description: Make a normally single-target Force power affect additional targets.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power that normally affects one target.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point for one additional target, or 1 Destiny Point for one target per four character levels.
mechanics.effect: Resolve the power against every selected legal target.

rules.name: Quicken Power
rules.description: Activate a standard- or move-action Force power much faster.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power that normally requires a standard or move action.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to activate it as a swift action, or 1 Destiny Point to activate it as a reaction.
mechanics.effect: Only the activation time changes; all other restrictions remain.

rules.name: Shaped Power
rules.description: Reshape a cone Force power into a long line or a selective area.

mechanics.trigger: Use a Force power with a cone area.
mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point to create a 1-square-wide line whose length is five times the cone length, or 1 Destiny Point to affect chosen targets within the cone's normal range.
mechanics.effect: Replace the normal cone with the selected shape.
mechanics.special: Selected targets and line targets must still be legal for the power.
